title: LATCH: LLM-Assisted Timing Closure Harness for Post-Route FPGA Optimisation
abstract: arXiv:2610.16625v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-route FPGA timing closure remains expert-dependent and computationally expensive. We present LATCH (LLM-Assisted Timing Closure Harness), a two-layer framework that separates large language model (LLM) orchestration from deterministic FPGA implementation and evaluation. Across sixteen designs and seven LLMs, a single-iteration study compares three agent control granularities - expert-written recipes, direct EDA operations and LLM-constructed procedures - to ask how much control an agent needs per attempt. Functional-pass rates are 98.2%, 71.4% and 17.9%, respectively; yet direct operations give slightly larger 3.4% median Fmax gains when passing, versus 3.2% for recipes. This exposes a trade-off between execution reliability and timing improvement. translated_title: LATCH：用于布线后FPGA优化的LLM辅助时序收敛框架
translated_abstract: 布线后的FPGA时序收敛仍然高度依赖专家经验且计算成本高昂。我们提出了LATCH（LLM辅助时序收敛框架），这是一个两层框架，将大语言模型（LLM）的编排与确定性的FPGA实现与评估相分离。在十六个设计和七个大语言模型上，一项单次迭代研究比较了三种智能体控制粒度——专家编写的方案、直接EDA操作以及LLM构建的程序——以探究智能体每次尝试需要多少控制权。三者的功能通过率分别为98.2%、71.4%和17.9%；然而在通过的情况下，直接操作能带来略高的3.4%中位数Fmax增益，而专家方案为3.2%。这揭示了执行可靠性与时序改进之间的权衡。基于这一权衡，一项多迭代研究将行动层级固定为专家方案，以探究如何最佳地组织重复尝试，比较了一种拟合的确定性启发式方法与……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: LATCH框架在布线后FPGA时序优化中揭示了智能体控制粒度下执行可靠性与时序增益之间的权衡（专家方案通过率98.2%但Fmax增益为3.2%，直接操作通过率71.4%但增益达3.4%），并据此固定采用专家方案来组织多迭代时序收敛尝试。
en_tdlr: LATCH reveals a trade-off between execution reliability and timing gains across three agent control granularities in post-route FPGA timing closure, and accordingly organises repeated optimisation attempts using expert-written recipes.
